groups.activity: Skirmish + Assassinate, shoot every green ramsled target
groups.meta: 12-16 Crimson normal, ~18-22 Steel Path, +4 (+12 SP) for a clean ramsled

rows.label: Crimson Talent
rows.note: full pity-shop cost for the Wrath side

conditions: Set matchmaking to Solo before entering Pontis Tower if you want your own Railjack — entering Public locks you to the loaner (Vena's Marrowbone) even if you switch modes after.
Your own Railjack intrinsics still apply even on the loaner ship.
bonuses: Shooting all the optional green ramsled targets roughly doubles Steel Path income for the same run and isn't explained in-game at all.
The ramsled segment also drops free Tellurium and MkIII Railjack parts.
Sisters of Parvos don't always spawn on Ryoku's side; Vena's side spawns them more often — bring armor/overguard strip or a buff dispel for Warding Halo.

disclosures.title: restart on a sticky reward table
disclosures.body: A launch-week bug repeated the same blueprint reward run after run until the client was fully closed and reopened. If you see three identical rewards in a row, restart before assuming it's just variance.

groups.sub: The Kuva Wytch (side Ryoku, kill Vena)
groups.activity: Skirmish + Assassinate, shoot the Orowyrm sequence targets
groups.meta: pays Emerald Talent identically to Crimson
conditions: The Orowyrm targeting is markedly harder to track than the ramsled — plan for more runs here than the Crimson side needs.

groups.activity: buy whatever the drops didn't give
conditions: Wrath needs a Pride Blade from The Kuva Wytch, and Pride mirrors it needing a Wrath Blade — farming only one node leaves an unbuildable set.
Duplicate blueprints can't be converted to Talents; buy the specific missing part from Hunhow rather than rolling for it again.
bonuses: Each Scoria's Angel completion also rolls a flat 7-item table at 14.29% each, three of them Wrath parts — drops often cover a chunk of the pity cost for free.
